source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separator_color = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda color: sum(row.count(color) for row in grid))
    horizontal = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == separator_color for x in row)]
    vertical = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == separator_color for i in range(h))]
    if horizontal and vertical:
        sr, sc = horizontal[0], vertical[0]
        tile = [row[:sc] for row in grid[:sr]]
        return [[separator_color if i == sr or j == sc else tile[i if i < sr else i - sr - 1][j if j < sc else j - sc - 1] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    if vertical:
        bars = vertical
        left, right = bars[0], bars[-1]
        tile = [row[left + 1:right] for row in grid]
        n = right - left - 1
        return [[separator_color if j in bars else (grid[i][j] if left < j < right else tile[i][j % n]) for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]

        tile = grid[:bar]
        n = bar
        return [[separator_color] * w if i == bar else tile[(i if i < bar else i - bar - 1) % n][:] for i in range(h)]
    return grid

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    if rows and cols:
        sr, sc = rows[0], cols[0]
        bar = grid[sr][0]
        tile = [row[:sc] for row in grid[:sr]]
        return [[bar if i == sr or j == sc else tile[i if i < sr else i - sr - 1][j if j < sc else j - sc - 1] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    if cols:
        bar_color = grid[0][cols[0]]
        left, right = cols[0], cols[-1]
        tile = [row[left + 1:right] for row in grid]
        n = right - left - 1
        return [[bar_color if j in cols else (grid[i][j] if left < j < right else tile[i][(j if j < left else j - right - 1) % n]) for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    if rows:
        # Repeat the non-bar pattern region. A final pattern block is the source when there are multiple bars.
        first, last = rows[0], rows[-1]
        if len(rows) > 1:
            n = h - last - 1
            tile = grid[last + 1:]
            bar_color = grid[last][0]
            return [[bar_color] * w if i in rows else tile[i % n][:] for i in range(h)]
        n = first
        tile = grid[:first]
        bar_color = grid[first][0]
        return [[bar_color] * w if i == first else tile[i % n][:] for i in range(h)]
    return grid
